## The quest continues

Venter's team made the DNA, but they used a cell that already existed. What is the future of making synthetic cells from non-living chemicals?

No one knows the full answer yet. Some things to weigh: what such a cell could teach us about how life began, how hard it is to build all the parts of a cell, and how long the work may take.

<!-- STEP -->
## A question for all of us

If a synthetic cell is developed, what ethical issues may arise? You might think about who decides how it is used, what happens if it escapes from a laboratory, and whether we would call it alive. Your answer may change as you learn more.
